title: T.N. Seshan, CEC v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: T.N. Seshan, CEC v. Union of India, (1995) 4 SCC 611
content.holding: 5-judge Bench held that ECI is a multi-member body where CEC and ECs have equal status, conditions of service, and voting power; decisions are taken by majority.
content.relevance: Established equality and parity between CEC and Election Commissioners.

evidence.note: 5-Judge Constitution Bench judgment in Writ Petition (Civil) No. 805 of 1994; 1995 INSC 350; (1995) 4 SCC 611; 1995 Supp (1) SCR 453.
